summary: Genenta Science S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the completion of its acquisition of the remaining 80.5% equity of A.T.C. S.r.l. from its shareholders on May 29, 2026, for an aggregate price of €9,604,076.82. The consideration was paid via set-off against the issuance of 24,625,838 ordinary shares at €0.39 per share to the sellers, who are subject to a 36-month lock-up. A put option allows sellers to resell shares to the company if the volume-weighted average price falls more than 30% below the issue price, exercisable between years three and five. Genenta also holds a call option exercisable from year one to three. The deal closed immediately after board approval on May 18, 2026. Watch for potential dilution and share price volatility relative to the floor price trigger.
